correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of all 5949 nonempty Rips faces and all 5679 positive-dimensional boundary compositions from dimension two upward and all eight mod-two boundary ranks gives Betti vector (1,0,0,46,0,0,0,0,0). The rational Betti vector follows from universal coefficients plus Euler characteristic -45. The finite wreath-product action has 1296 distinct permutations, exactly 22 conjugacy classes, and every class trace follows from signed simplex Lefschetz. An independent orbit-union inclusion calculation checks all 1296 traces, and exact group averaging proves the invariant dimensions 0 and 2. The claim does not assert integral torsion-freeness or equivariant homotopy.

value.rationale: This is a complete symmetry invariant of the canonical ternary Hamming three-cube Rips complex at its nontrivial three-sphere-wedge scale. The full character distinguishes degree-three homology modules with identical dimension; the absence of full fixed classes despite two translation-fixed classes is a nontrivial structural consequence. It offers a concrete base case for studying nonbinary Hamming equivariant persistent homology, but no family generalization is claimed.
